Dr Allen is highly recommended for his industry knowledge, experience, network and passion for growing dental groups. The dental industry is fraught with challenges and Dr Allen is a rare breed of dentist who also has a MBA!!  Having sought his advice and consulting , my dental group is now enjoying a 15% increase in turnover in just a short few months.
He is nothing short of amazing and highly recommended as the top dental consultant in the region.

Dr Allen goes above and beyond exploring what it takes to be a master dental practitioner . I would highly recommend anyone looking to improve their clinical and managing skills to run a successful dental practice and take it to the next level . Thank you Dr Allen for all that you have taught me !

It was such an amazing experience learning lots of new things related to creating better environment in clinic and getting to know many ways of increasing new patients in my practice.

I wish I attended this course years ago!!! With this new ways of approaching patients and management we made a much better & stronger team which effecting our monthly revenue rapidly

Dr.Allen & his team were very friendly and dedicated to share their experiences in a 3 full days program in Thailand and we really enjoyed lots of delicious foods ;)

Dr. Allen has a lot of experience and great ideas that helped my dental practice  in California to grow in the positive direction. He is the person to see if you want to grow or improve your dental practice.

I had the pleasure to work with Dr Allen on a few projects and highly recommend his services. His high class clinical experience combined with business mindset and international as well as intercultural experience will help you find the best solutions. Dr Allen and his team are just amazing in every way.

I went to Dr. Allen management similar in Phuket, Thailand.
It was amazing  experience, well organize, friendly and professional. We had 3 days seminar and practice sessions of Management , leadership and business finance.

My knowledge about managementbefore was ok but I knew that not perfectly clear. After the course, I can say that I now know way more about how to manage my staffs and run my business better.  I’m glad that i took the class.

I recommend to everyone who’s willing to improve your skills.

I think I've made the right decision for my life to attend Dr. Allen's dental coaching. My career life changed alot because of his guidance. He's very professional and shared alot of thoughtful advice. Thank you Dr. Allen!

Nothing but great things to say. Dr Allen has been highly instrumental in a business endeavor in SE Asia and delivered an amazing end-to-end consulting experience, all the way until successfully signing several leads we weren't able to identify / recruit ourselves. Highly recommend.

I decided to attended the management training course in Phuket, Thailand.
The sessions were very instructing, very informative and well organize.
I improve my knowledge with discussion and work activities during the 3 days.
Dr. Allen is always available for discussion and ready to share personals experience.
Highly recommend.
